verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework with a CLI, and opting out of telemetry is a fair question for that kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Flags like --no-agents-md control scaffolding, not data collection, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
